mars_dust.base_color_effect: warm desaturated deposit; do not uniformly recolor vertical surfaces
mars_dust.normal_height: very shallow powder buildup; use mask/normal, not new geometry
avoid: equal density on ceilings and vertical faces

A.name: Blast Core
A.base_color: near-black char plus exposed substrate; retain some material identity
A.metallic: follow exposed metal mask; char itself non-metallic
A.normal_height: spall, bubbled/peeled coating, coarse char only where silhouette is not required

B.name: Strong Heat
B.base_color: burnt brown/dark red/grey with substrate visible locally
B.normal_height: bubbled paint and medium crack relief

C.name: Smoke Heat
C.normal_height: small scratches and shallow cracks only

D.name: Intact / Control
D.structure_source: outside NT-BLD-015 Zone C within Zone D control boundary
surface_stack: very light heat influence near boundary

reusable_masks.soot: upward plume bias from blast/fire origin; avoid isotropic noise
reusable_masks.heat: gradient outward from Zone A/B; hue/roughness modulation
reusable_masks.burn_char: high-frequency broken edge inside broad burn region
reusable_masks.paint_loss_edgewear: edge curvature/contact-driven; must reveal correct substrate
reusable_masks.rust: secondary moisture/oxidation mask; do not dominate fresh blast core
reusable_masks.ash_extinguisher: powdery pale/grey deposits in low areas and intervention paths
reusable_masks.oil_coolant: localized dark/wet contamination around machinery, floor flow paths and damaged pipes

runtime_rules.mask_resolution: 512 for small props; 1K shared by default; 2K only for hero damage zones
runtime_rules.blend_strategy: base material + shared damage masks; avoid unique full PBR set per object
runtime_rules.geometry_change: forbidden in NT-BLD-017; large deformation already belongs to NT-BLD-015 Structure

qa.adobe_reference_visual_qa: PASS; A→B→C→D→pure dust progression is visually distinct; D/pure dust orange is reference only, not direct final BaseColor
